arduino.setup:
pinMode(relayPin_${COMP_SUFFIX}, OUTPUT);
digitalWrite(relayPin_${COMP_SUFFIX}, HIGH); // Assumes active-low trigger

micropython.globals:
from machine import Pin
import time
micropython.setup:
relay_${COMP_SUFFIX} = Pin(${IN}, Pin.OUT)
relay_${COMP_SUFFIX}.value(1) # Assumes active-low trigger
micropython.loop:
relay_${COMP_SUFFIX}.value(0) # Energise relay
time.sleep(1)
relay_${COMP_SUFFIX}.value(1) # De-energise relay
time.sleep(1)
